item.title: Police search for suspects after random carjacking in Saskatoon parking lot
item.description: Police say a 65-year-old man had his van stolen on Feb. 2 in a convenience store parking lot in the 2400 block of Preston Avenue South.

item.title: U of S set to shut down alumni email accounts later this month
item.description: As of Feb. 15, the U of S is closing down all alumni email accounts, citing rising costs and the need for enhanced security.

item.title: SaskEnergy investigating fuel theft, cost still unknown
item.description: The Crown has fired 13 SaskEnergy employees after a report disclosed internal fuel theft in 2024-25.

item.title: Saskatoon police investigating first homicide of 2026
item.description: Saskatoon police are reporting two men came to St. Paul's Hospital with stab wounds early Tuesday morning. One man died from his injuries.

item.title: Five Saskatoon art galleries to explore in February
item.description: This month, Saskatoon art galleries include explorations of masculinity and expression, sustainability in fibre arts, culture, conflict and our connection to our environment.

item.title: Mixed reviews on proposed Millar Avenue reconstruction result in deferral
item.description: Coun. Donauer said he understands the safety concerns the project hopes to address, but impacted businesses aren't feeling heard.

item.title: Taxi driver accused of sexually assaulting woman 'in vulnerable state'
item.description: A 33-year-old woman told police she was unlawfully confined and possibly sexually assaulted after being picked up by a taxi on Jan. 3.

item.title: It's official: Sask. Rattlers are now Saskatoon Mamba; New ownership, name unveiled for CEBL team
item.description: The Saskatoon Mamba will play seven games at Merlis Belsher Place and five at SaskTel Centre games during the upcoming CEBL season.

item.title: Two Saskatoon murder trials on hold due to hospitalization, fire
item.description: Two murder trials underway at Saskatoon Court of King's Bench have been delayed, for different reasons.

item.title: Strike: Saskatoon Paramedic Association votes in favour of job action
item.description: "Frankly, our members are at the point of exhaustion and burnout on a daily basis."
